method: Independent offline Git-byte reading/hash validation, recursive contract/source selector validation and exhaustive record-level static least-privilege review; no derive.py execution and no inherited R4 conclusion accepted as authority.

findings.exact_missing_proof: Participant-specific syscall/filter startup closure and credential/observer entitlement design for all seven participants.
findings.counterexample: native-confinement kernel_filter is a prose deny list without architecture syscall table, role allowlist, argument predicates, startup transition or complete alternate descriptor mutation closure. supervisor.c performs clone3/execv and retained-handle signals; observer.c census opens postgres connection. Unique UID/key labels alone do not derive permissions or a fixed catalog witness.
findings.minimum_next_action: Specify exact per-role syscall and argument predicates, startup seal ordering, namespace/UID/capability/filesystem/channel entitlements and independently bound catalog observation. Re-review source-to-effect closure offline.

findings.exact_missing_proof: Exhaustive physical endpoint creation/transfer/descendant/reconnect domain and exact independent same-original-handle observation authority.
findings.counterexample: 274 endpoint rows repeat fixed actor authority language but do not derive every startup descriptor/descendant from an exact syscall closure. CATALOG_OBSERVER/CONSUMER_OBSERVER identity does not specify a fixed authenticated provenance transport for the original connection; separate pg_stat_activity census cannot observe original session setting before/after. All seven reseal conjunctions consequently remain unclosed.
findings.minimum_next_action: Derive complete endpoint generation/custody graph from finalized role policies and provider operations; design fixed credential-free original-handle independent observation and exact extinction entitlements.

findings.exact_missing_proof: 422 individually retained obligations lack complete semantic source-to-TEST target, applicability, effect and privilege-origin graph.
findings.counterexample: R3/audit_binding/92bcf1c31b8569490027 maps audit_binding:decision_id APPEND_PREPARED to a proposed audit store by label, yet decision_id canonical semantic predicate is not proven equivalent to a fixed TEST field mutation; ACTOR_AUTHORITY is NOT_PROVEN and exact_delta_complete false. Every obligation inspected has unresolved applicability/effect proof. Provider acl.c explicitly distinguishes inheritance and SET ROLE paths plus defaults/grantor/superuser.
findings.minimum_next_action: Complete per-obligation semantic field/effect/provider applicability interpretation and enumerate/classify all mutation and authority edges, preserving unknowns.

findings.exact_missing_proof: Minimum exact capability/principal/credential/template/executor/outcome/observer domain cannot be derived from incomplete physical authority denominator.
findings.counterexample: All six capability artifacts have derived_records empty and required counts null. Generic executor prohibition is a constraint, not an exhaustive fixed-operation catalog or cross-capability rejection proof. Fixture correction restores intended wrapper but no complete alternate/transitive/PUBLIC/default/SD/CREATEROLE/bootstrap exclusion follows.
findings.minimum_next_action: After static denominator closure derive exact minimal capability catalog and exhaustive ordered cross-capability rejection constraints; revalidate fixture authority paths without implementation.
